title: security: RBAC v2 enforcement + KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: Customers in regulated industries requested stronger guarantees around key residency and audit trails for RBAC v2 policy enforcement. This PR hardens RBAC v2 to enforce KMS region pinning (data residency), tightens audit logging for policy decisions, and includes a migration plan for existing policies.

What this changes: 1) RBAC v2: introduce residency-aware policy evaluation path that rejects creation of resources with KMS keys outside allowed regions when the org policy requires region pinning. 2) KMS integration: add region metadata propagation to KMS key references and a validation hook in the KeyResolver used by the control plane. 3) Audit logging: add structured audit entries for policy evaluations (policy_id, decision, rule_matched, key_region, requester_location) and ensure entries are emitted before mutating responses are returned to callers. 4) Admin UX: add admin-only diagnostic endpoint to preview policy violations for a given tenant.

Backward-compatibility/migration: Default behavior is opt-in via feature flag (rbac_v2_region_pinning) for the first release; when enabled, creation/update APIs for resources referencing KMS keys perform region validation. Migration tool included in this PR performs a scan and emits remediation recommendations; the operator-run migration can be used before turning enforcement on globally.

Testing & QA: unit tests for policy evaluator (coverage for allow/deny/conditional flows), integration tests exercising KMS metadata propagation, e2e tests for audit log shaping and retention tagging, manual canary in staging with a subset of tenants.

Security considerations: rolling enforcement to avoid accidental downtime; detailed release notes and SRE runbook added. Linear tickets: ENG-3245 (RBAC v2 residency enforcement), SEC-1128 (Audit logging hardening), PM-215 (admin diagnostics).
commits: Initial RBAC v2 residency-aware evaluator + unit tests
KMS key resolver: propagate and validate key.region metadata
Audit-log: structured policy decision entries and retention tags
Migration tool: scan existing resources and emit remediation plan
Fix: tighten race between audit emission and response commit
Tests: add integration and e2e canary scenario
Docs: release notes and SRE runbook
review_comments: Jordan Liu: Can we ensure the audit entries are emitted synchronously before the mutating DB transaction commits? The previous incident happened because logs were delayed. -- Author: moved emission to pre-commit hook and added retry/backoff.
Priya Raman: Migration tool should not mutate resources by default. Suggest making dry-run default. -- Author: updated tool to dry-run by default and added --apply flag.
Marcus Hayes: Add explicit unit test for cross-region proxying scenario. -- Author: added integration test rbac_kms_residency_test.go scenario 5.
Security review (automated): no sensitive data in logs. -- Author: redacted key identifiers and added key hashing feature for logs.
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 (opt-in via feature flag). Structured audit entries for policy decisions. Migration tool to scan and recommend remediations. Admin diagnostic endpoint for policy preview. See docs/release-notes/2026-02-26-rbac-kms-residency.md for full details and SRE runbook.
testing: Unit + integration + e2e; staging canary run with subset of tenants. All CI checks green after second e2e rerun.
rollout_plan: 1) Enable feature flag in staging and run migration dry-run for all tenants. 2) Apply remediations for flagged tenants or notify them with remediation plan. 3) Gradually enable enforcement for 5% of tenants for 24h, monitor for rejects and user impact. 4) Increment to 25/50/100% with SRE signoffs. Rollback: toggle feature flag off.
notes_for_ops: SRE runbook added to docs; alerting on high rate of policy rejections (SLO: <0.5% unexpected rejects). Audit logs are sharded and tagged with retention: compliance=7y for regulated tenants.
changelog_summary: RBAC v2: region pinning enforcement, KMS resolver validation, structured audit logging, migration tool, admin diagnostics
